title: test(pm): pin core.quotePath=true in the real-git quoted-path fixtures
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9PaNqu2SSrzw7UtdmjG9BE7)_
Fixes #33846
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个受管合并守卫自测里的真实 git 夹具，在 git 命令行上钉住 `core.quotePath=true`。
- 为什么改：夹具只剥 GIT_* 环境变量，不挡用户或系统 gitconfig；机器上设了 `core.quotePath=false` 时，两条 CONTROL 断言会误红（只会红，不会假绿）。
- 风险与回滚：只动自测夹具，不动守卫判定逻辑，断言数不变（530 / 745）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的夹具 `g`，再看 `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的夹具 `fg`。
- 两分钟验证：`HOME=$(mktemp -d) sh -c 'git config --global core.quotePath false && node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test'`，预期 745 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The CONTROL rows of the NUL-path fixtures (from PR #33804) witness that git C-quotes the fixture names when a read runs without `-z`. Both fixture wrappers run real git under `gitFreeEnv()`, which strips every `GIT_` key but leaves `HOME` / `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `/etc/gitconfig` in reach, so a box with `core.quotePath=false` in any config file spells the non-ASCII names raw and reds the two CONTROL rows.

The fix adds `-c core.quotePath=true` to the command-line pins each wrapper already carries (`user.email`, `user.name`, `init.defaultBranch`, `commit.gpgsign`):

- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: the `g` wrapper of the quoted-path fixture (`guard-quoted-paths-`).
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: the `fg` wrapper of the quoted-path fixture (`governed-merges-quoted-paths-`).

**Why the `-c` pin rather than `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` + `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`:** command-line `-c` outranks every config file level (system, global, XDG, local), so one pin covers all of them. The env route needs two variables to cover only global and system, and it would have to go through `gitFreeEnv()`, which strips every `GIT_` key by design, so it means changing the shared helper and its callers. The `-c` pin also sits in the same place as the fixture's existing identity pins. `scripts/git-env.mjs` is not changed, so no caller of `gitFreeEnv()` moves.

Forced test edits: none. No assertion, expected value or case count changed. Only the two fixture wrappers' git argument lists and their comments changed.

## Tests

The acceptance asked for these runs: each self-test with `core.quotePath=false` set in a throwaway global config, before and after the fix. `gitFreeEnv()` strips `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`, so the throwaway config goes in through `HOME`, plus one `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` run.

| run | queue-guard `--self-test` | governed-merges `--self-test` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| base 895783a1, default config | exit 0, 530 cases | exit 0, 745 assertions |
| base 895783a1, `HOME` with `core.quotePath=false` (ablation) | **exit 1**, 1 of 530 failed: the CONTROL row | **exit 1**, 1 failure: the #33620 CONTROL row |
| head cd7b9ac5, `HOME` with `core.quotePath=false` | exit 0, 530 cases | exit 0, 745 assertions |
| head cd7b9ac5, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` with `core.quotePath=false` | exit 0, 530 cases | exit 0, 745 assertions |
| head cd7b9ac5, default config | exit 0, 530 cases | exit 0, 745 assertions |

<details><summary>Ablation output at base (core.quotePath=false)</summary>

```text
check-governed-queue-guard:
  ✗ ⛔ CONTROL the-fixture-names-are-ones-git-C-quotes-without--z: ["\"skills/a/two\\nlines.md\"","skills/a/文档.md"]
✗ check-governed-queue-guard self-test: 1 of 530 case(s) failed.

check-governed-merges:
✗ check-governed-merges --self-test — 1 failure(s)
  • ⛔ #33620 CONTROL the-fixture-names-are-ones-git-C-quotes-without--z: [".github/workflows/café.yml","\"skills/a/two\\nlines.md\"","skills/a/文档.md"]
```

The newline name stays quoted under `core.quotePath=false`. Only the non-ASCII names lose their quotes, which is the `every(startsWith('"'))` limb the CONTROL row reads.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's mechanism assumptions held: no `core.quotePath` pin existed in either fixture at 895783a1, and `gitFreeEnv()` does not cover config files. One small correction: at base, neither file's comment named `core.quotePath`. The governed-merges comment said only "git would C-quote". Both comments now name it.
- The `lowrisk-rename-` real-git fixture in check-governed-queue-guard is in the low-risk arm region (another card is working there) and was left alone. It uses only ASCII names, so it does not depend on `core.quotePath`.
- A system-level `/etc/gitconfig` leg was not run, because it would mean writing a file outside the workspace. `-c` outranks the system level by git's documented precedence.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head cd7b9ac5 derived 35 commands. All 35 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "35 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 35 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
